# Dental Design SD

> Dental Design SD is a boutique dental practice in San Diego, California, led by Dr. Kathrina Agatep, DDS. The practice specializes in TMJ treatment, Invisalign, same-day crowns, dental implants, cosmetic dentistry, and airway/sleep dentistry. It serves patients in Sorrento Valley, Mira Mesa, UTC, and surrounding San Diego neighborhoods.

## About

- [Our Practice](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/dentists-san-diego-ca): Overview of the practice philosophy, mission, and what sets Dental Design SD apart — including a no-pressure environment, convenient hours, and state-of-the-art technology.
- [About the Doctors](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-dentists): Profiles of the dental team, led by Dr. Kathrina Agatep, DDS, with expertise spanning cosmetic dentistry, TMJ, airway, and restorative care.
- [Office Tour](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-dentist-office): Photos and details of the modern, boutique-style dental office located at 9540 Waples St, San Diego, CA 92121.
- [Reviews](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/reviews): Patient testimonials and reviews highlighting clinical quality, staff friendliness, and comfort.
- [Smile Gallery](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/smile-gallery): Before-and-after photos of cosmetic and restorative dental cases.
- [Blog](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/blog): Educational articles on dental health, procedures, and practice news.

## Services

- [TMJ Treatments](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-tmj-dentist): Diagnosis and treatment of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders and jaw pain, including customized oral appliances and therapy.
- [Botox for TMJ Pain](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/botox-for-tmj-san-diego): Therapeutic Botox injections to relieve TMJ-related jaw pain, teeth grinding (bruxism), and headaches.
- [Invisalign](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-invisalign): Clear aligner orthodontic treatment for straightening teeth discreetly in adults and teens.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/how-much-does-a-crown-cost-in-san-diego): Same-day CEREC crowns and traditional crowns; includes pricing information for San Diego.
- [Dental Implants](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-dental-implants): Permanent tooth replacement with implant-supported crowns and restorations.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-cosmetic-dentistry): Smile makeovers including veneers, teeth whitening, bonding, and aesthetic treatments.
- [BioClear Matrix](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/bioclear-matrix-san-diego): Minimally invasive tooth restoration using the BioClear composite injection molding technique.
- [Pinhole Surgery](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/pinhole-gum-surgery-san-diego): Scalpel-free, suture-free gum recession treatment using the Pinhole Surgical Technique.
- [Airway Dentistry](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-airway-dentist): Evaluation and treatment of airway issues, sleep-disordered breathing, and sleep apnea using oral appliance therapy.
- [Emergency Treatment](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/emergency-dentist-san-diego): Same-day emergency dental care for toothaches, broken teeth, lost fillings, and other urgent needs.
- [Laser Cold Sore Treatment](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/laser-cold-sore-treatment-san-diego): Fast, in-office laser treatment to heal and prevent cold sores (herpes labialis).

## Financial Information

- [Dental Insurance](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/dental-insurance-san-diego): Information on accepted insurance plans and how the practice works with dental benefits.
- [Office Fees](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/san-diego-dentist-office-fees): Transparent fee schedule aligned with San Diego industry averages from Fair Health Consumer.
- [In-House Dental Savings Plan](https://member.kleer.com?slug=HN2J): Kleer membership plan for patients without insurance — covers preventive care with discounts on additional services.
- [Sunbit Patient Financing](https://apply.sunbit.com/DentalDesignSD): Financing option through Sunbit for spreading treatment costs over time.
- [Cherry Patient Financing](https://www.dentaldesignsd.com/cherry-patient-financing): Additional financing option through Cherry for flexible payment plans.
